title: The SIG-UI-042 hostile-reader gate can only pass with two or more reviewer names and gates only the /editorial-standards/ page: a truthful 'no review performed' record fails the web build, and no dossier build consults the gate
evidence: assertReviewReleasable throws 'hostile-reader review for <v> needs two independent reviewers (SIG-UI-042); got N' when review.reviewers.length < 2 (editorial.ts:221-226) and is called at build only from editorial-standards.astro:26; grep -rln 'assertReviewReleasable|getHostileReaderReview' web/src web/tests -> data.ts, editorial.ts, editorial-standards.astro, editorial.test.ts only; grep -rn 'template_version|hostile' web/src/pages/dossier web/src/pages/research-dossier -> 0 hits; editorial.test.ts:78-79 pins the committed record at >=2 reviewers. So the page text 'release is blocked until every finding is dispositioned' blocks no dossier release, and replacing the fixture reviewers (E1 NEW-1 / E3 NEW-1) with the true state (0 reviewers) requires a code change, not a data change. Mechanism behind E1-02.

GL-GATE-08's recorded risk 'egress-IP block exposure on shared vendor infra' is the PrimeGov case; SIG-INGEST-046c names EU DSM Art. 4 reservations. title: §26 rule 7 ('honor opt-out immediately') has no mechanism: no per-host opt-out register exists, and stopping a host requires editing the package-data registry and rebuilding/redeploying the ingest images (config baked in)
evidence: grep -rn 'opt_out|opt-out|optout|do_not_crawl|denylist|blocklist' over connectors/src policy/src -> only procurement replay-fixture comments and the dot_511 media-field blocklist; PoliteFetcher.fetch (net.py:375-400) consults the api allow-list and robots verdict (recorded, not enforced) but no opt-out list; the only stop is ingestion_permitted in sources.toml, loaded as package data (registry.py:219 load_table('sources')) and copied into the image (ops/Dockerfile:56 COPY connectors), so an opt-out needs a code/data change plus rebuild of the 4 ingest builds (G1 NEW-10). Spec §26 rule 7 (:4491) 'Honor opt-out immediately and record it in the compact'. Refines E1 NEW-15 (which records rule 7's absence from the GL-GATE-08 risk record, not the missing mechanism).
